pages.title: Fuel Goes Everywhere
pages.text: Oil from [#](2E5AAC)[TFMG](entry://industry/tfmg_oil)[#]() is the pack's main liquid fuel, and other mods accept it through shared fluid tags. Pipe it once and many things can drink from it.

Where TFMG fuels burn:
- Any Blaze Burner, piped in: diesel, gasoline, kerosene, naphtha, heavy oil. Napalm superheats it
- Crafts & Additions' Blaze Burner with Straw: also crude oil and creosote

- Create Propulsion thrusters: diesel, gasoline, kerosene, naphtha
- Northstar rockets: diesel, gasoline, kerosene, naphtha

Not into oil? Crafts & Additions makes Seed Oil and Bioethanol from crops, and Garnished makes Peanut Oil. Create: Liquid Fuel lets a plain Blaze Burner burn those, and Bioethanol and Peanut Oil superheat it.

Rockets also run on Northstar's own Hydrogen, Methane, Hydrocarbon and Biofuel. Thrusters take Turpentine from pine resin, and Solid Fuel Thrusters just burn coal or planks.\
\
Soot from air scrubbers burns as solid fuel too.
